notes.title: bug fixing
notes.content:
Fixed the issue where the Ion Flame and Calm Eye modules were reversed when selecting at the start of the game.
Fixed the bug where the camera got stuck when sprinting in the Staff interface.
Adjusted the mechanism that completely blocked the wheelchair when constructing crystals.

notes.title: Adjust difficulty, game balance & Full English version released!
notes.content:
Updated the full English version of the current chapter !

Game features:
Some of the conversations have been modified.
Added save point.
Improved balance and fluency in the second and third battles.
Adjusted attack range and attack of some creatures.
Modified the key to heal the hero health.
Added/adjusted some combat descriptions.
Added a small amount of instruction.
All damage cells will now follow the mouse.
Reduced the tip cell, increased the content displayed by each single tip cell.
The jump cell will follow the mouse.

BUG fix:
- Background music cannot be tuned to the highest setting using E or click BackGround+.
- Puzzles can be done clicking the mouse.
- When combat status is withdrawn, the read will remain in combat.
- Timer bug of game play.
- The refresh rate of monsters is too frequent.
- Error of Clear display.
- First icon of saving slot have error.

Unresolved issues:
The last tube of BOSS blood is displayed incorrectly.
The health point is not obvious.
The laser will penetrate the map.
